correctness.rationale: For positive ranks \(r_1<\cdots<r_P\), ROC-AUC is exactly \(1-\sum_j(r_j-j)/(P(N-P))\), and average precision is exactly \(P^{-1}\sum_j j/r_j\). Exhaustive exact enumeration of all binary rankings with both classes present through \(N=5\) proves the stated weak and strict boundaries and the complete first layer.

value.rationale: ROC-AUC and average precision are standard threshold-free summaries used for model comparison, but they encode different ranking preferences: uniform positive-negative pair weighting versus extra emphasis on early positives. The smallest fixed-prevalence reversal is therefore a natural exact diagnostic for metric choice, and the full first layer reveals the two minimal ways that redistribution of ranking error can change the preferred model.
